integrity: All arguments are stated self-containedly; finite checks corroborate but are not substituted for infinite proofs. Bibliographic originality is a best-knowledge judgment with noted residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact numerical result is dimension three only; in higher odd ternary dimensions only a lower bound is proved. Classification concerns minimum six-vertex admissible classes, not every optimal colour partition. Independent priority and proof review not performed.
title: Four majority C-colours in the ternary three-cube and a persistent odd-dimensional improvement
